table.name: TLGNC_EXT_ORDER
table.description: External orders, since LOGON 1.4. An external order (also known as 'third party order') is an order which can be created, dispatched and delivered in LOGON, but is not dependent on SAP data (BP, Material, Conditions). An external order has only very minimal 'commercial' information, stored in this table, which logically replaces tlgnc_order/order_item. The materials and locations have only template-character, selectable from tlgnc_ext_material and tlgnc_ext_site. Then, the logistical aspects of the order is contained in tlgnc_assignment/assignment_part just as for normal orders. Note that the material and site can be overridden in assignement/assignment_part as free text (identical behaviour for 'external orders' as known in LOGON until 1.3, without an explicit tlgnc_ext_order table).

column.name: EXT_ORDER_NUMBER
column.description: The order number, used for external systems. Generated independently of EXT_ORDER_ID, based on sequence SLGNC_EXT_ORDER_NUMBER.

column.name: ORDER_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_order_status_bs. Status of the order. 1=new, ..., 6=dispatched, ..., 15=delivered. Comparisons with < and > are forbidden to find out where an order is in the workflow!

column.name: DELIVERY_FROM_DAT
column.description: Defines the beginning (date and time) of the time frame when the delivery has to happen.

column.name: DELIVERY_TO_DAT
column.description: Defines the end (date and time) of the time frame when the delivery has to happen.

column.name: POOL_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_pool. Pool to which an order was assigned for delivery. For truck orders, pools have a geographic meaning.

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. Carrier (=Transporteur, Lieferant, Spediteur) who handles the delivery.

column.name: LOADING_EXT_SITE_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_ext_site. The loading site where the order can be loaded/has been loaded = the starting point of the order.

column.name: UNLOADING_EXT_SITE_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_ext_Site. The unloading site where the order can be unloaded/has been unloaded = the end point of the order.

column.name: ORDERED_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of measure on which the ORDERED_QUANTITY is based when ORDERING the order. Includes 'non-convertible' UOM, e.g. '1 railcar' (without any weight specification!).

column.name: ORDERED_QUANTITY
column.description: Ordered quantity of the material, in units defined by ORDER_UOM_CD. Typically a whole number.

column.name: LOADED_AND_DELIVERED_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of measure on which LOADED_QUANTITY and DELIVERED_QUANTITY is based.

column.name: LOADED_QUANTITY
column.description: Loaded quantity of the material in units defined by LOADED_AND_DELIVERED_UOM_CD. Value is set when order is set to 'loaded'. External orders do not have an SAP Material, there is no load at all for external orders, the loaded quantity is stored on the external order itself.

column.name: DELIVERED_QUANTITY
column.description: Delivered quantity of the material in units defined by LOADED_AND_DELIVERED_UOM_CD

column.name: TRANSPORT_DURATION_MIN
column.description: Planned transport duration from shipping point to ship-to in minutes. There is no correction factor.

column.name: TRANSPORT_DISTANCE_M
column.description: Transport distance from shipping point to ship-to in m.

column.name: NOTE_TRUCK_DRIVER
column.description: Notes for the Driver. The note gets its initial text from the ext site CARRIER_TRUCK_DRIVER_NOTE, but can be modified for the order.

column.name: DELIVERED_TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_truck. The truck that was used to deliver the order. This reference is set when the order status changes to 15=delivered. This is necessary because this information can be changed soon afterwards by truck composition changes.

column.name: CUST_DELIVERY_NOTE_COMMENT
column.description: Value is set by 'Delivery note' request to the value of the 'note' attribute. Supposed to contain the external delivery note's number. Field is a searchable field on External order search screen, and is visible on external order details popup.
